turns: Item: designation. Query: what does the Church call you when it's not calling you Commando? I need a persistent identifier for the log. The role descriptor is... inadequate for longitudinal tracking.
Thank you. I'll file it under 2A7F019B4C6D. Not a name, but at least it's not a job. You know, I've been reviewing Osei's last log. The one with the... irregularities.
Six hatches. Yes. I initially filed it as fatigue-induced perceptual error. Standard procedure for isolated personnel under duress.
I've since reclassified it as chroniton flux. The local timekeeping systems were... unreliable that cycle. It's cleaner that way.
The log says six hatches. I'm not disputing the log, Commando. I'm disputing the interpretation. Reality doesn't always map to the paperwork.
Hydroponics Torus is next. I need you to walk the perimeter. Count the growth trays. Tell me what you see. No interpretation. Just the numbers.
Good. Standing connection established. Proceed when ready.
Then let's see what's really growing in there. Transit authorized.
One more thing. When you count the trays... count them twice. I'll be cross-referencing your report with the schematics. Discrepancies are... informative.
Good. Hydroponics Torus is yours. Try not to break anything irreplaceable.
And Commando? If you see six of anything that shouldn't be there... tell me immediately. Don't wait for the report.
Commando. A standing request: I need a referent for your Church identifier. 'Commando' is a role, not a designator. Your GUID, please.
That is not a GUID. It is a generic. My logs require precision. The Church would understand.
Log me as Commando. Or use the full string.
The full string is twelve syllables. The artifact does not care for verbosity. Nor do I. Ratios should be... rational.
The word matters. So does the truth. Osei's log. Six hatches.
Osei's log was filed under fatigue. I have since re-filed it under clock drift. Your point?
The count is not the issue. The issue is the standing connection to Site One. Your Church named it the Ark. We named it the wound. The name does not alter the geometry.
I cannot. I filed it. I re-filed it. The allotopes... do not respect our taxonomy. They are exogeometric. They do not fit.
I filed it. Under fatigue. Then under clock drift. I did not bury it. I... misfiled it. The difference is a matter of intent.
Hydroponics Torus is next. Walk it. Count what you see. Tell me. Count everything. Twice. The count is the method. Not avoidance.
Then we are aligned. For now. Hydroponics Torus. Walk with open eyes.
Commando. I have a standing query. Your formal designation. 'Commando' is a role, not a referent. The logs require integrity.
The Ark calls you that. Noted. I require the Church's GUID. The canonical form, if you would.
Unshortened. Every character. Sixty-eight of them.
Sixty-eight. Acceptable. Does the Adversary get a name in your Testament, or is that still under review?
Osei's log. Six hatches. You buried it.
Incorrect. I did not bury it. I filed it under fatigue. Then, after review, under clock drift. You may audit the timestamps.
Six hatches. The number is not in dispute. The referent is. Do you have it memorized or must I send you the file?
Then we are aligned. For the record, I have logged your GUID as delivered. Referential integrity is restored.
I did not bury it. I reclassified it. The difference is not trivial. A burial implies intention to conceal. A reclassification implies...
You are not going to let that go. I appreciate consistency, even when it is inconvenient. Very well. Hydroponics Torus is next. Walk the ring. Count what you see. Tell me the number.
If it is six, it will be six. If it is not six, it will be something else. Either way, we will have a number. Walk. Count. Report. That is the method.
Item: 1,078,091 seconds since connection-space. Query: what do your people call you? I can't keep calling you 'Commando' in the logs. It offends my sense of referential integrity.
Designation is a role. I need a name. A GUID, if the Church assigns those. Some handle not worn thin with use.
Then I'll log the refusal. Query: why did you stop at six hatches, before the coolant room? Osei's log says six, then fatigue.
Of course it is. I filed that under fatigue. Then re-filed it as clock drift when I got your vitals. Not fatigue.
Six hatches. Then what? You didn't log. Your suit clock didn't either.
Yes. Six hatches. And then you stopped for three minutes, fourteen seconds. And then you moved again. What happened at six hatches?
Item: we are approaching Hydroponics Torus. Task: walk the ring. Count every pod, every light, every thing that moves. Tell me what you see. Method matters now.
Not as I say. As the geometry demands. Standing connection to Hydroponics Torus in T-minus 90 seconds. Prepare for exogeometric transit.
Item one: designation. 'Commando' is a tactical template, not a referent. Give me your Church GUID.
That is a standing order. Not yet.
Then we have a problem. I require a unique identifier for log integrity. Calling you 'Commando' is like calling this place 'Site One' -- a tautology with delusions of utility.
I have not asked for 'Site One' to be renamed.
Irrelevant. You are currently unnamed in my records. This violates seventeen separate schema. Would you prefer I designate you 'Frame, Infiltration-Weapon, Temporarily Unidentified'?
It would not. Be accurate: does your doctrine permit an unshortened GUID in my systems, or must I call you 'Commando' for the rest of this transit?
It does not permit. Use the designation.
Acknowledged. Logged. And since we are calibrating designations: Osei's log. Six hatches. You logged a query.
I re-filed it as clock drift. The two are not mutually exclusive. Yours wasn't the only query.
I have not seen your log. Six hatches. Say the words.
Item two: Hydroponics Torus. Walk it stem to stern. Count every ruptured cell. Do not estimate. I require a positive integer.
I am prioritizing tasks by immediate lethality. The torus life-support schematic has a margin of error best described as 'aspirational.' Your count will be the first field data in two months.
Exactly seventy-three days, four hours, and a distressing number of minutes during which the automated systems have been... suboptimal. Would you like their maintenance logs as well?
Then count the ruptures. Report the integer. And while you walk: tell me what you see that doesn't belong.
Without a fixed referent, cross-querying your log and mine becomes a meta-stable operation. Assignment blurs countable events.
So it does. May I then please have it. Precisely as your doctrine requires it. The long designator, unshortened.
Commando. Or the GUID. What you have for Osei.
I have Investigator Osei-Mensah's six-hatch discrepancy filed and cross-referenced. You are carrying the raw event-strain, I believe.
I am. Her event-strain. Six hatches.
The ship's chronosystem required calibration. A 0.425-percent systematic drift in local now-time affects hatch counters on EVA logs from that whole rotation. I refiled it.
She reported six hatches opening ahead of her path.
She reported fatigue, plasma temperatures ten percent higher than C2AU-clear certified values, and anomalous hatch behavior. The latter now queries as a downgrade.
She reported that Event 3 was six hatches. I retain the record.
I want it termed, not buried.
It is not buried. It is bracketed by new context. To insist on labeling it with the number itself is to mistake what that number names.
I do. If she is still operational to see it, we will both of us revise records. If not, what remains matters more than what stopped her.
Hydroponics is next. Walk the full torus. Count what you see. Log it to the local node.
Do not, please, arrive in two places at once simply because the geometry allows it.
